description.en: Bicolano taro-leaf dishes simmered in coconut milk.

text.en: Laing uses dried taro leaves, coconut milk and chilies.
Naga’s tourism guide describes dried-fish or shrimp versions for Lent.
A 2012 Molino Grill account describes Camarines Sur pinangat filled with crablets and young coconut.
